answer: One identity anchors to one registered basalt quarry concession: one concession is granted per plot, and each block carries a batch code; one concession backs one identity, a second claim refused. A fake costs $6,500 in fees and bond, plus 240 days of permitting and inspection; the registry publishes each shipment as a public signal, exposing silent quarries. Cheapest cheat is an exhausted plot for $1,800, but the seller surrenders its backing and a dead plot fails the live check; blocks lacking the pigment mark are refused. One hundred fakes cost $650,000, 100 quarries and 24,000 days.
